morphology.pattern_note: 按英语姓氏作为完整专名识记，不按马来语词缀拆分。通常写作 Sharpe；所列 IPA 为常见英式读音，并非经核实的马来语词条读音。

senses.zh_definition: 夏普：英语姓氏 Sharpe；本条仅作专名识别，不能据此认定为马来语普通词。
senses.en_definition: Sharpe, an English surname; a proper name rather than an established Malay common word.
senses.ms_definition: Nama keluarga Inggeris yang lazimnya dieja Sharpe; bukan takrif kata umum bahasa Melayu yang disahkan oleh DBP.
senses.nuances: 数据包没有 DBP 释义，故不能标作已核实的 official 马来语词条。仅凭小写 sharpe 无法确定具体人物。Sharpe 作为姓氏可见于 [Oxford 人物辞典](https://academic.oup.com/oxford-dictionary-of-national-biography/reference/63486/reference-article-abstract/582565660)。nasbah Sharpe 中也保留此专名，但 sharpe 单独不等于该比率。

dual_scenarios.context: 公文 / 新闻 / 职场汇报
dual_scenarios.ms: Pihak urus setia mengesahkan bahawa Profesor Sharpe akan menyampaikan ucaptama pada persidangan tersebut.
dual_scenarios.zh: 秘书处确认，夏普教授将在该会议上发表主旨演讲。
dual_scenarios.en: The secretariat confirmed that Professor Sharpe will deliver the keynote address at the conference.

dual_scenarios.en: Has Mr Sharpe arrived in the lobby yet?

messages.speaker: Hafiz (同事)
messages.ms_spoken: Dah, dia tunggu kat situ. Saya nak turun jemput dia sekarang.
messages.ms_standard: Sudah, beliau sedang menunggu di situ. Saya hendak turun untuk menyambut beliau sekarang.
messages.zh: 到了，他在那儿等着。我现在下去接他。
messages.en: Yes, he's waiting there. I'm going down to meet him now.

etymology.historical_story: Sharpe is a surname, and one well-documented route into technical vocabulary is through William F. Sharpe. In 1966 he introduced a mutual-fund performance measure under a different name; later writers called it the Sharpe ratio. This illustrates how a personal name can enter Malay technical discussion without becoming an ordinary Malay adjective. [Sharpe's account](https://web.stanford.edu/~wfsharpe/art/sr/sr.htm).
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 看到 Sharpe 的大写 S，先想到“姓夏普的人”；末尾 e 在常见英语读音中不另成音节。
